# Warden's Brand

A magic weapon: attunement by a class, the damage and the properties,
and a mastery this edition leaves unprinted. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: 5e_2014
  card-type: item
data:
  name: Warden's Brand
  category: Weapon (longsword)
  rarity: rare
  attunement: by a paladin
  damage: 1d8 slashing
  properties: Versatile (1d10)
  mastery: Sap
  weight: 3 lb.
  description: |
    You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

    While you hold the sword, you can use a bonus action to make its blade smoulder until the end of your next turn; a creature hit by it in that time takes an extra 1d6 fire damage.
```
